messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer needs to update the purchase order reference on an invoice to fix reconciliation issues.
  quote: we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.
- problem: The invoice generation process does not allow for easy correction of purchase order references, leading to reconciliation issues.
  quote: We need to adjust the purchase order reference on the invoice you sent — it’s causing reconciliation problems with our finance team, and we’re hoping you can help with the purchase order correction.
